business_summary.text: Uday Jewellery Industries Limited is a Hyderabad-based manufacturer and B2B supplier of natural gemstone-studded fashion jewellery and polki diamond-studded bridal jewellery, part of the Sanghi Global Group, selling mainly to organised retailers in India and exporting to the UAE and USA.

tax_litigation.status: Closed it is in favour of the Company.

industry: Consumer Discretionary > Consumer Durables > Gems, Jewellery And Watches

operating_notes.text: Company is developing a job-work model in which large customers supply the gold and it is paid for manufacturing services, expected to lower its gold inventory requirement and raise capacity utilisation.
Lightweight plain gold jewellery is being added as a new focus area alongside its gemstone-studded and CZ-studded collections.
Supply tie-ups with a few large corporate clients are at a preliminary stage with no definitive agreement, MoU or binding commitment executed.
